summary: Metadata for angles, lunar nodes, and optional modern points used by the app.
body: Points can be displayed and interpreted, but Chiron and Black Moon Lilith remain optional modern layers and should not be used in traditional dignity, sect, rulership, or time-lord logic.
definition: Point metadata describes non-planet chart factors used for display and interpretation weighting.
appUsage: Show Chiron and Black Moon Lilith only when the user enables the optional point layer.
Weight optional points up when they are angular or aspect a personal planet or angle.
Keep angles and lunar nodes separate from planets in UI grouping.
note: Imported from the project policy bundle; source file was not copied into the repo.

asc.label: Ascendant
asc.plainTranslation: the rising degree; self-presentation, body, approach (depends on exact birth time)

mc.label: Midheaven
mc.plainTranslation: the culmination; public role, vocation, reputation (depends on exact birth time)

dsc.label: Descendant
dsc.plainTranslation: the setting degree; partnership, the other, what we seek in one-to-one bonds

ic.label: Imum Coeli
ic.plainTranslation: the lowest point; home, roots, private foundation, ancestry

north_node.label: North Node
north_node.plainTranslation: direction of growth; the unfamiliar work this life leans toward

south_node.label: South Node
south_node.plainTranslation: the familiar, already-developed pattern; comfort to move beyond

chiron.label: Chiron
chiron.plainTranslation: the persistent wound and the capacity to help others with it

lilith.label: Black Moon Lilith
lilith.plainTranslation: the lunar apogee; instinct, refusal, what will not be tamed or shamed
